points: Your site shows $250 off, 4322 reviews and 330 000+ customers, yet 0 of 28 ads use any of them. Buyers want that proof before paying $296. Open two ads with a review quote and put $250 off on the creative.
Your site offers 46% off, yet 0 of 28 ads mention any offer or discount. A first time buyer sees no reason to act today. Put the 46% saving in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

15 of your 28 ads open on one story, only 4 minutes to help your body slow down, so most buyers hear one pitch. Test three new openers from your own product, such as the twice a day routine, against it.

Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer who has not clicked through has no answer before they decide. Answer it in the first line of ads aimed at new buyers.
